description:

title: The Many Lives of Benjaman Kyle

When a man with amnesia is found behind a Burger King, Hot Snakes Media's Shannon and Eric Evangelista and ex-FBI agent Ken Maxwell uncover a web of lies, forcing them to ask if Benjaman Kyle is a victim or the mastermind of an extraordinary hoax.

title: The Many Lives of Benjaman Kyle
description:
S01 E02 — Meet William Powell
Hot Snakes Media uncovers Benjaman Kyle's disturbing secrets, dark-web activity, erased files, and ties to the Burger Chef killings, before DNA reveals he's William Powell, a man hiding a past more sinister than imagined.

title: The Many Lives of Benjaman Kyle
description:
S01 E03 — The Bouncer
New witnesses describe William Powell as dangerous and deceptive; as Hot Snakes Media digs deeper, stories of violence and alleged mob ties reveal that Benjaman Kyle's past may be darker and deadlier than anyone believed.

title: The Many Lives of Benjaman Kyle
description:
S01 E04 — The Man Who Knew Too Much
He said he forgot who he was; the truth? He remembers, and it's terrifying.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S07 E05 — I'm Telling You Im Dangerous
In rural Missouri, police receive a haunting call from a 50-year-old man claiming he shot three people inside his home. Detectives uncover that this impulsive massacre has a motive and that the killer is a psychopath obsessed with control.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S07 E08 — I Am the Weirdest Guy
A mother awakes to find her two sons with their throats cut; their aunt's boyfriend confesses to his mother, and she wears a wire to capture her son; as he admits his guilt, it's clear how a psychopathic rage led to violence.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S08 E06 — My Pretty White Shoelaces
Hikers in Portland discover the badly decomposed body of a raped and strangled young girl; A month later, another woman turns up brutally murdered in same fashion; the prime suspect is a homeless drifter harboring dark sexual fantasies.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S07 E07 — Make Sure You Get My Good Side
A road rage incident turns deadly as an elderly man is beaten to death by a teenager who claims he was acting in self-defense; detectives not only find holes in his story but uncover that he is a remorseless and manipulative psychopath.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S08 E03 — Unorthodox and Weird
A 19-year-old woman vanishes, and the suspect is a former high school classmate with whom she had been communicating days earlier. The family is weary, for the suspect has a notorious past filled with sexual deviancy and homicidal urges toward women.

title: Married to Evil
description:
S02 E03 — Deadly Delivery
A successful Florida family has their American dream shattered when a mysterious figure dressed as a clown shoots a loving mother on her doorstep; the case goes cold for decades until an unexpected break helps bring the killer clown to justice.

title: Married to Evil
description:
S02 E06 — Dying to Leave
After years of abuse, Cheryl musters the courage to leave her husband, Thom; he stalks her and torments their two children; when Cheryl finds a new love, her ex sets a trap to take the ultimate revenge.

title: Married to Evil
description:
S02 E05 — Out of Control
When Angie meets Joe, her family and friends aren't sure what to make of their relationship; the couple marry and have kids, but soon Angie becomes isolated from her loved ones and trapped in a spiral of abuse that ends in a horrific triple homicide.

title: Married to Evil
description:

Jenny and Mike are teen sweethearts but after marrying, Mike begins a campaign of control and violence against his wife and children; just as Jenny plans to escape her living nightmare, Mike finds out and decides he will do anything to stop her.

description:

description:
